notes: The leaf continues the relative-fundamental-group discussion. Formula (17) identifies the kernel using universal covers, followed by the literal parenthetical sans hyp de suite exacte. Formula (18) replaces a cancelled kernel expression by two isomorphic group expressions. A seven-arrow diagram occupies the left middle margin. The lower paragraph interprets the relative group using geometric points/fibres and formula (19).

Only this page packet, its supplied current notation table, the common rules/protocol, and this reader’s files were used. The original image and each native half were inspected once, followed by fifteen saved contextual crops. No OCR, other-page witnesses, PDF text layer, external research or TeX compilation was used.

The saved crop script is edition/review/149_scan112_crops.py. It records every original bounding box, applies autocontrast and LANCZOS enlargement, and refuses to overwrite a crop already saved. All fifteen generated crops were inspected.

The first T in the top insertion is retouched: its lower crossed strokes are real but do not isolate an earlier character. It is retained as unsure T. The second T is clean and has no independent overbar. The top insertion attaches after déduits de, before the continuing de telle façon.

The cancelled right-hand side of (18) remains fully represented, including Ker, the connector, both doubtful group expressions and closing parenthesis. The raised replacement is set above the cancelled baseline, following the source layout. The extra high mark at the far right is accounted for as the doubtful superscript of the old cancelled target E directly below/left; it is not silently omitted or made into a third live replacement term.

The inherited nested doubts inside the cancelled formula are not supplied M ids in marks.tsv. They remain in the candidate and the doubts list; no invented decision ids were added. Only the twelve supplied ids M0051–M0062 occur in decisions.
The word hyp has no detached stop on the crop. sans is preserved against H’s opposite reading sous l’hyp. The whole parenthetical expression was inspected, not only the differing word.

The diagram contains seven arrows, with all heads and directions checked twice against its whole crop: three top-row arrows point left, X→Y′ and Y′→Y point down, X_Ytilde→Ytilde points down, and Ytilde→Y′ points left. The small isolated point near the lowest Y is not promoted to punctuation or a vertex because its attachment is not secure.

The first geometric point is added above géométrique with a curved leader attaching before the comma and qui définit. The leader is not read as punctuation or cancellation. The word prenant stays live; the thick middle strokes follow the word and do not constitute a separate strike.

All ten geometric-point Greek letters remain unresolved. Alternative order zeta/xi follows the supplied notation table only after each local occurrence was inspected; it is not treated as a resolution. The first such superscript in (19) is heavily retouched, but no earlier character is securely separable from that blackening.

In (19), capital Pi has a flat cap and two separate vertical posts and a small subscript 1. The case change from both witnesses’ pi is based on these strokes, consistent with the current notation table. Small looped X-index forms are kept consistently with the other X-indexed geometric-point expressions; no distinct alpha is introduced.
The terminal quotation uses raised quotation marks, not guillemets, and does not contain a stop after géom. The separate stops in i.e. and after the final X/Y are preserved.

All-ink baseline count is 25: 18 main baselines, three insertion baselines, three rows of diagram labels, and standalone foliation 111. This count treats the physically separate diagram rows as independent of neighbouring prose even where their heights overlap.

Some contextual rectangles include tips of nearby superscripts or descenders. Such clipped continuations are not duplicated as new words. The complete corresponding expressions are included in their own audit boxes and the candidate.

No independent mathematical proof or formal verification of the claims was performed. The hypothesis wording and authorial revisions were transcribed from ink without repairing them to fit an expected argument.
